title: IDPC Decision 2025: The complainant alleged:- that the controller failed to provide a complete respo
text:
Type: Data Protection Complaint

Description: The complainant alleged:- that the controller failed to provide a complete response to her access request made in 2019;- that the controller failed to respond to her erasure request made in 2019; and- that the complainant made another access request in 2025, and the controller unjustifiably withheld certain personal data from its response, and unjustifiably extended the prescribed time-period to respond to the request.

Outcome: Firstly, the Commissioner decided that to ensure procedural fairness and safeguard the integrity of the investigation, the scope of the investigation shall not extend to the complainant’s allegations regarding her 2019 requests, given the nearly six-year delay between the events complained of and the lodging of the present complaint.Regarding the complainant’s 2025 access request, the Commissioner confirmed that no additional personal data is in the controller’s possession beyond what was already disclosed, and decided that the extension invoked by the controller was justified.

Corrective Action: The Commissioner ordered the controller to develop and implement an internal policy to ensure that its employees are properly trained and equipped to respond to data protection requests in the future.
